welcome.title: Welcome to Pit Officer
welcome.description: Set up the control plane deliberately. Nothing is traded or connected until you choose a source and a workflow.

product.copy: Pit Officer is the operator panel for risk control. It keeps accounts, balances, policies, market-data sources, audit records, REST access, MCP commands, and signing keys in one local service.

dropCopy.title: Drop-copy registrar
dropCopy.copy: Record orders, fills, account state, and audit events after execution without blocking the upstream venue.

preTrade.title: Pre-trade gate
preTrade.copy: Approve or reject orders before they leave the system, with account balances and policy barriers applied first.

surfaces.title: REST, MCP, and FIX
surfaces.copy: Operate from the panel, REST clients, MCP agents, and FIX-oriented flows as they are enabled.

operations.title: Operator ledger
operations.copy: Inspect positions, held funds, breaches, policy changes, approvals, logs, and service health.

preTrade.copy: For allow-or-deny pre-trade control, create accounts, assign positions or cash balances, then define policy barriers. If buying-power control is not needed, accounts and balances can stay empty.

marketData.copy: Market orders, locked prices, cross-currency exposure, and realized PnL need a market-data source. You can connect a live provider later or install a static BYO preset now.

optional.copy: A pure registry or audit workflow can start without accounts, balances, or feeds. Add the controls only when the order path must be allowed or blocked by Pit.
